verdict.rationale: Vue's own docs describe it as an "incrementally adoptable" framework that scales from a library to a full framework and builds on standard HTML. Independent community reports confirm it is easy to add "minimally here and there to existing templates to spruce up old applications" and call it a jQuery successor for websites. Missing for 10: detailed first-party documentation of no-build/script-tag usage, mounting components into existing server-rendered DOM (in-DOM templates), and a concrete hands-on walkthrough.
